name: Codex CLI (OpenAI)
summary: Periodically sends a small amount of anonymous usage and health data to OpenAI (feature and configuration usage, model, auth mode). OpenTelemetry log export is separate and disabled by default.

optOut.instructions: Add [analytics] with enabled = false to ~/.codex/config.toml. Set otel.metrics_exporter = "none" to disable a custom OTLP metrics exporter as well.
